data_fields.name: lock_reach_units
data_fields.donor_constant: none in donor (no reach limit on ranged search or retention)

best_idea: Pick the lock by a fixed order (hostile before talkable, then fewest walk steps, then smallest facing gap), stop the search at the first hostile's step count, and keep the locked target while a non-attack button is held, dropping it only when it dies, hides or leaves the lit area.
decision_why: Take the pick order and the held-button retention as the Frankendom lock rule with the donor defects fixed (stable tie-break by monster id, one distance metric, a lock reach limit, pick on the server tick). The pick stays engine-side with the hate list; the client only draws the frame and sends intent.
acceptance: With three attackers around the player the target frame shows the nearest hostile (not a talkable NPC) and the facing one on a tie; holding a non-attack button keeps the frame on its target until it dies or leaves view; an attack press re-picks for that swing; a server test asserts the struck monster is the one the engine picked for that tick.
